metadata.description: Japan's first open-source AVM — 'the Linux of AVMs' for land appraisal. White-box hedonic regression, full coefficient disclosure, Apache-2.0. By Signal Yield Advisory, a Japanese licensed real estate appraiser.

plugins.name: tochi-satei-kun
plugins.description: Japan's first open-source AVM for land appraisal — 'the Linux of AVMs'. Re-estimates hedonic regression coefficients on every run from MLIT transaction data, fully discloses coefficients/p-values/standard errors, and generates broker-side worksheets plus client-facing assessment reports (xlsx).

author.name: Koichi Matsuda (Licensed Real Estate Appraiser, Japan, 2002-)
